neighbours.label: ' all' in 'most of all' and French ' surtout', an emphatic top-of-list marker (also ' even')
fire: But most of all, he wanted peace at home.
And most of all, thank you for coming.
But perhaps most of all, the food was good.
Mais surtout, il faut rester calme.
Above all else, but most of all, stay honest.
Yet most of all, she missed the sea.
Mais surtout, nous devons agir vite.
Perhaps most of all, the town needs jobs.

notes: Card: ' even' 14, ' all' 4, ' especially' 2, ' surtout'. Probes: ' all' 1.13 and 0.98, ' surtout' 0.29; 'Most of the work' 0.02, 'may even leave' 0.01 (so ' even' did not repeat and is left out).
